desc:
🚀 WORLD 2 IS HERE! 10 new biomes, 80 new pets, new bosses and barn skins!

🐾 Welcome to Steal A Pet And Ride It!

How to Play:
📦 Steal cages from sleeping bosses
🏃 Run home before the boss catches you!
🐣 Open cages to discover rare pets
🐢 Ride your pets to become even faster
💰 Earn cash from the pets in your barn
⚡ Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and barn
🌎 Explore 20 biomes across 2 worlds
🔄 Rebirth for huge boosts and keep all your pets!

✨ NEW:
🪐 Moon, Ocean, Crystal, Shadow, Storm, the Black Hole and more
🏠 A second barn and new barn skins
🦖 Limited Dinosaur Era Cage with 12 limited pets
☄️ Meteor showers bring rare cages
🎯 Lasso thieves and drop banana peels!

🎁 Join the Snail Riders community to claim a FREE Legendary pet!
⭐ Like & Favorite so you never miss an update!
👫 Play with friends to earn bonus cash!

🎮 Play on PC, Mobile, Tablet and Console
